competing_hypotheses.claim: The conflicting Level-1 imbalances reflect venue-specific liquidity rather than a single XRP-wide order-book signal.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Only one price level is available on each venue; no synchronized full books or trades.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Displayed imbalance may be transient and need not represent executable demand or supply.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: No cancellation, replenishment, fill or queue-position data were retrieved.

competing_hypotheses.claim: A common directional pressure is not established by these observations.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Kraken and OKX have different quote imbalances and different reference windows.

data_quality.source_independence: Kraken and OKX are separate venue-origin sources, but both were retrieved through the same web retrieval channel.
exclusion_reasons: Retrieval channel did not expose raw HTTP wire bytes or exact retrieval timestamps.
